title: Skinny: Regenerate dissector from packet-skinny.c.in

notes.body: @johnthacker and also step for (re)gerenate this dissector too ?
Could make sense to do, though IIRC it requires running `pip install cogapp` to get it to work. Possibly add that to our container images?
